players.product: Ceramic housings and aluminium nitride ceramic substrates for optical communication modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Sinopack investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: silicon photonics chips generally need ceramic substrates in packaging, and it supplies core ceramic products (ceramic housings and substrates) to domestic and overseas optical-module companies; its thin-film substrates, with advantages in surface flatness and metallization-layer thermal stress that help long-term reliability and heat dissipation of silicon-photonics modules, 'occupy the main position' in 1.6T optical modules (company claim), while thin-film and DPC substrates are different technology routes.
